levels.effect: **Advantage** on any roll to resist poison. Immune outright to ordinary disease. No Ki, no Gift Check.
Advantage extends to serious, dangerous poisons and illnesses too, not just minor ones.
Spend **1 Ki** to purge an active poison or disease from your system outright, on command, no roll needed.
You stop aging entirely, natural or accelerated. Immunity to poison and disease upgrades from Advantage to outright, even against exotic toxins and genuine plagues.
Full immunity to poison, disease, and aging of any origin, natural or supernatural. You can still be killed, violence, injury, and the like still work, you simply can't be worn down or aged to death.

gifts.markdown:
### Undying Vigor

Poison, disease, the passing of time... Your body refuses to succumb to these things. You can be killed. You can be broken, bleed and die - but you won't die from natural causes. Sickness, age and decay will not be what ends you.

**Purging a poison or disease (Level 3+) always costs Ki. There is no mastery discount to free.**

| Level | Effect |
|---|---|
| 1 | **Advantage** on any roll to resist poison. Immune outright to ordinary disease. No Ki, no Gift Check. |
| 2 | Advantage extends to serious, dangerous poisons and illnesses too, not just minor ones. |
| 3 | Spend **1 Ki** to purge an active poison or disease from your system outright, on command, no roll needed. |
| 4 | You stop aging entirely, natural or accelerated. Immunity to poison and disease upgrades from Advantage to outright, even against exotic toxins and genuine plagues. |
| 5 | Full immunity to poison, disease, and aging of any origin, natural or supernatural. You can still be killed, violence, injury, and the like still work, you simply can't be worn down or aged to death. |

**Adders**:

- **Cleansing Touch** (Lesser, 3 pts): spend 1 Ki to purge a poison or disease from a touched ally instead of only yourself.
- **Preemptive Ward** (Lesser, 3 pts): once per Day, grant yourself Advantage against a specific known poison, disease, or aging effect before you're ever exposed to it.
- **Halted Decay** (Greater, 6 pts): once per year of in-game time, subtly reverse a few years of accumulated aging, on top of the Level 4+ stopped-aging benefit.
- **Venom Keeper** (Lesser, 3 pts): requires Level 3. When you purge a poison, you can hold it in your blood instead. Your next weapon or unarmed hit that deals a Health Level before the Scene ends leaves that target Envenomed. Requires Level 3.
- **Poison Eater** (Lesser, 3 pts): once per Scene, when you resist or purge a poison or disease, recover 1 Ki.
- **Plague Sense** (Lesser, 3 pts): you sense poison and disease within Close: a tainted cup, a sick crowd, a coated blade. No roll; you know it's there, not what it is.
- **Clotting Blood** (Lesser, 3 pts): Bleeding ends on you at the end of each of your Rounds.
- **Deathless Flesh** (Greater, 6 pts): Advantage to resist curses, rot and life-draining effects that wear you down over time rather than strike you.

**Limiters**:

- **Slow Purge**: your immunity isn't instantaneous, at any Level. A poison or disease still runs its full course, symptoms included, for up to a Day before your body fights it off. The Level 3+ Ki purge still works, but only shortens that Day down to a Minute rather than clearing it outright.
- **Vulnerable Youth**: your immunity to aging (Level 4+) doesn't protect against magical or supernatural rapid-aging effects specifically, only the natural passage of time.
- **Silent Carrier**: you're personally immune, but you can still carry and unknowingly transmit disease to others without ever showing symptoms yourself.
- **Fever Purge**: every purge is violent: after you use the Level 3+ purge, you're Exhausted for the rest of the Scene.
- **Specific Bane**: at creation, choose one substance (silver, a certain herb, blessed water). Your immunities never apply to it, and exposure leaves you Envenomed with Disadvantage to resist.
- **Rejects Remedy**: your body fights off outside help too. Medicine and first-aid rolls to treat you have Disadvantage.
- **Brittle**: your body resists slow death but not violence: Disadvantage on rolls to resist Bleeding and Staggered.

giftCheckText: **The Gift Check.** 2d10 under your **current Ki**, roll low, the same shape as a [core roll](rules.md#core-mechanic). Succeed and it's free. Fail and it costs you 1 Ki until you refill. It reads current Ki rather than your maximum, which is why Gifts are dependable while you're fresh and start letting you down once the day has worn you thin.

flaws.name: Amnesia
flaws.blurb: Part of your past is missing - see [Amnesia](#amnesia) below for the 5-level breakdown.

levels.effect: A single traumatic event is missing - one specific memory gone, everything else intact.
A cluster of related memories is missing - the days or weeks around a specific incident, or one relationship entirely forgotten.
A significant span of time is missing - months or years, not just one moment. Name, identity, and abilities are intact, but real gaps exist in personal history and relationships.
Most personal history is gone - only fragments remain. Still knows their own name and can act normally, but life before a certain point belongs to a stranger.
Forgotten their entire identity - may not know what Skills or Boons/Gifts they have.

flaws.flavour: There is a hole where a piece of your life used to be. You know it's there the way you know a tooth is gone - you keep checking. Sometimes something surfaces. A smell, a name, a room you have never been in. Then it's gone again.

flaws.name: Antagonist
flaws.blurb: Someone or something is set against you - a rival, an enemy, a hunter who doesn't give up - see [Antagonist](#antagonist) below for the 5-level breakdown.

levels.effect: A minor rival - someone who competes with or needles you personally. Low capability, mostly a nuisance.
A capable individual enemy, or a small hostile group/local authority keeping an eye on you.
A well-resourced enemy or organized hostile group actively working against you.
A powerful, dangerous enemy or organization with real reach, actively hunting you.
A nemesis-tier antagonist - extremely powerful, far-reaching, and personally invested in your downfall. Relentlessly hunts you as a top-priority target.

flaws.flavour: Somebody out there is thinking about you right now, and they are not wishing you well. They know your name. They know where you eat lunch. You made an impression on exactly the wrong person, and they are patient.

flaws.name: Anxiety
flaws.blurb: Anxiety that doesn't need a reason and doesn't switch off - see [Anxiety](#anxiety) below for the 5-level breakdown.

levels.effect: A specific, narrow fear or recurring nightmare - unsettling, but rarely interferes with function.
A phobia that actively triggers avoidance or hesitation when confronted with its source.
Generalized anxiety - chronic worry and disrupted sleep color everyday decisions, not just one trigger.
Panic attacks - sudden, incapacitating episodes of panic under stress, not just avoidance.
A pervasive anxiety disorder - constant hypervigilance, frequent panic attacks, and deeply entrenched avoidance that fundamentally limits day-to-day life.

flaws.flavour: Your brain runs a threat assessment every waking second and it never files a clean report. The stove. The email. The look somebody gave you four years ago. You know most of it isn't real. Knowing has never once made it stop.

flaws.name: Berserk
flaws.blurb: Once you're going, you don't stop until it's over - see [Berserk](#berserk) below for the 5-level breakdown.

levels.effect: Once triggered by real danger, cannot voluntarily disengage from the current fight - must keep engaging until an enemy is defeated or flees.
Level 1, plus: while triggered, cannot declare a Slow [Action Bracket](rules.md#action-brackets) - full aggression only, no called shots or concentration.
Levels 1-2, plus: must always act against the nearest hostile target - no picking tactically who to engage.
Levels 1-3, plus: the trigger doesn't end just because the original threat is gone - any new hostile that appears keeps the fight going.
Levels 1-4, plus: keeps fighting even when badly hurt - won't retreat or stop to protect themselves, only stopping when physically unable to continue (unconscious, restrained, or no hostiles remain).

flaws.flavour: There is a switch, and you are not the one who flips it. Once it's thrown you are a passenger - swinging until there is nothing standing and nobody left to swing at. Afterward, other people tell you what you did.

flaws.name: Code of Conduct
flaws.blurb: A rule you set yourself and won't break, even when breaking it would help - see [Code of Conduct](#code-of-conduct) below for the 5-level breakdown.

levels.effect: A minor, low-stakes personal restriction - inconvenient, rarely costly. Strict vegetarian/vegan; never tells even a white lie; always pays a debt the moment it's owed; won't enter a home uninvited.

A real behavioral rule that occasionally costs something. Never draws a weapon first; refuses payment for helping someone in genuine need; never abandons a task once started, however small; always keeps a promise made to a friend.

A binding code that actively shapes major decisions. Once I draw my blade, it must taste blood; any promise made must be kept regardless of personal cost; a formal challenge, once accepted, can't be walked away from; a secret entrusted to them is kept even under real pressure.

A severe restriction that limits options in dangerous or critical moments. Refuses to harm anyone significantly weaker than themselves; an enemy must always be given a chance to surrender before a killing blow; cannot break a vow even to save their own life.

An absolute, life-defining restriction. I cannot kill anything, no matter the cost; a vow that cannot be broken under any circumstance, even to save the people they love; can never refuse a genuine request for help, regardless of personal danger.

flaws.flavour: You have a line. You drew it yourself, nobody else is obligated to respect it, and that is exactly why it counts. It has cost you money, opportunities and at least one friendship. You would draw it again tomorrow.

flaws.name: Dependent
flaws.blurb: Someone relies on you, and has to be protected or provided for - see [Dependent](#dependent) below for the 5-level breakdown.

levels.effect: A dependent who mostly manages on their own - checks in occasionally, needs a little financial or emotional support now and then.
A dependent who needs regular, real support - time, money, or care on a recurring basis, though not helpless.
A dependent who can't protect themselves and needs real intervention when trouble finds them - a young child, an elderly parent, someone seriously ill.
A dependent who is a frequent liability - regularly endangered by your own life (enemies, work, reputation), requiring real risk to protect.
A dependent who is entirely helpless without you and a prime target - enemies know exactly who to threaten to get to you.

flaws.flavour: Somebody needs you. A kid, a sibling, an old friend who never got their feet under them - whoever it is, they can't do this without you, and they don't get a vote in what you've gotten yourself into. Every plan has to include them.

flaws.name: Destitute
flaws.blurb: You have no money - anywhere from a bad patch to nothing at all - see [Destitute](#destitute) below for the 5-level breakdown.

levels.effect: A rough patch. [Creation-Wealth](resources.md#wealth-at-character-creation) is **0** instead of the default 2 for gear shopping at creation, and no Resources Pool or Discretionary points may be spent on Wealth while this Flaw is held - buy it off first - see [Starting Packages](weapons.md#starting-packages) for what's still available at Level 0. Doesn't follow you past creation; whatever put you here (a lost job, a bad breakup, a bad month) is already turning around.
Chronically tight. As Level 1, and it doesn't go away - living paycheck to paycheck, or with no paycheck at all, is an ongoing fact of your life, however your Resources ended up built.
Real precarity. As Level 2, and something concrete is currently unstable - unreliable housing, an unreliable income source, or a debt actively being chased.

Genuinely impoverished. As Level 3, and it's visible enough that people react to it on sight - shapes first impressions the same way Notable Appearance or Notoriety do, just for money instead of looks or reputation.

Nothing left. As Level 4, and there's no safety net at all - no one to call for a loan, no fallback plan, and whatever put you here is bad enough to be a real, ongoing story hook (GM's call on specifics).

flaws.flavour: Money is something that happens to other people. You know which places let you sit for hours over one coffee, which shelter has the fewest rules, and exactly how far what's in your pocket will stretch. You are very good at arithmetic you never wanted to learn.

flaws.name: Directionless
flaws.blurb: You get lost. Reliably - see [Directionless](#directionless) below for the 5-level breakdown.

levels.effect: A mildly unreliable sense of direction - occasionally turns around even in familiar places, rarely costs more than a moment.
A poor sense of direction - regularly gets turned around in unfamiliar areas, needs to double-check directions rather than trust instinct.
Actively bad - gets lost even in semi-familiar places without a map, guide, or other aid to follow.
Severe - cannot reliably navigate even short, familiar routes without external aid; easily disoriented under any pressure or unfamiliar layout.
No functional sense of direction whatsoever - completely dependent on others or tools to get anywhere; could get lost in their own home under stress or darkness.

flaws.flavour: North is a rumor. Everyone else seems to have a map running somewhere behind their eyes and you never got issued one. You have been lost inside a building you work in. "It's two blocks that way" means nothing to you.

flaws.name: Fragile
flaws.blurb: The body works against you - see [Fragile](#fragile) below for the 5-level breakdown.

levels.effect: Mildly delicate - bruises easily, tires a bit faster than average, but functions fine day to day.
Noticeably weaker - real physical exertion (lifting, running long distances) is harder, minor injuries take a bit longer to heal.
Frail - the body struggles under real exertion or stress; a condition flares up under pressure; recovery from harm is markedly slow.
Seriously compromised - sustained exertion risks real harm; even routine physical demands can trigger a flare-up or setback; wounds that would be minor for others become serious.

The body is failing - barely able to sustain ordinary physical demands without real risk; any injury is dangerous and slow to heal; a single hard fight could be life-threatening regardless of what actually connects.

flaws.flavour: Other people get a bruise. You get a hairline fracture. Whatever everybody else's body does to absorb a hit, yours never learned. You break easily, you heal slowly, and you have built your whole life around knowing both.

flaws.name: Gun-Shy
flaws.blurb: When violence starts, you falter - see [Gun-Shy](#gun-shy) below for the 5-level breakdown.

levels.effect: First round of combat, act last within your declared [Action Bracket](rules.md#action-brackets), regardless of Initiative.
Level 1, plus: for the first round, Fast actions are treated as Normal and Normal actions are treated as Slow - Slow actions can't be taken that round at all.
Levels 1-2, plus: unless 1 Ki is spent, they don't act at all in the first round of combat.
Levels 1-3, plus: while in combat, they act at [Disadvantage](rules.md#advantage--disadvantage).

Levels 1-4, plus: the Ki-to-act requirement from Level 3 applies every round, not just the first - without spending Ki each round, they're frozen entirely; when they do act, it's at Disadvantage throughout.

flaws.flavour: The moment it kicks off, there is a gap. Everyone else is already moving and you are still catching up to the fact that this is happening. It isn't cowardice - you get there. You just get there late, and late is expensive.

flaws.name: Illiterate
flaws.blurb: You can't read, to one degree or another - see [Illiterate](#illiterate) below for the 5-level breakdown.

levels.effect: Illiterate only in the local language/script - fully literate (possibly exceptionally so) in their own.
Illiterate in every language/script they're likely to encounter while traveling, though still fully literate at home - the gap is broader than just "here."
Only semi-literate even in their native language on top of that - basic reading/writing is possible, but real fluency isn't there anywhere.
Functionally illiterate everywhere, including their own native language - cannot meaningfully read or write at all.
No concept of written language whatsoever - doesn't register that symbols represent language in the first place.

flaws.flavour: The letters are right there and they don't come together. You have built an entire life around not needing them to - you memorize, you ask, you get somebody else to check the form. It works right up until someone hands you something and waits.

flaws.name: Impaired Senses
flaws.blurb: One of your senses is dulled, or gone - see [Impaired Senses](#impaired-senses) below for the 5-level breakdown.

levels.effect: A minor gap in one sense - reduced but functional (mild nearsightedness beyond normal correction, slight hearing loss in one ear, a dulled sense of smell). Real but manageable.
A significant impairment in one sense - noticeably worse than normal, actively affects tasks that rely on it, but not total loss (poor low-light vision, muffled hearing, no sense of smell at all).
Total loss of one sense - fully blind in one eye, fully deaf in one ear, or a complete loss like smell/taste. Other senses compensate, but real gaps remain.
Total loss of a primary sense - fully blind or fully deaf, relying entirely on other senses and/or tools/training to compensate.
Total loss of multiple primary senses - both blind and deaf, or similarly extreme. Complete reliance on remaining senses and outside support.

flaws.flavour: One channel is down. You have rerouted around it well enough that people forget, and you let them. It stays forgotten until somebody speaks up from your bad side, or the thing you needed to notice was over there.

flaws.name: Incantations
flaws.blurb: A Gift of yours only works if you can say a specific phrase out loud - see [Incantations](#incantations) below for the 5-level breakdown.

levels.effect: One specific Gift requires speaking a short trigger phrase aloud to activate - audible to anyone nearby, and it simply doesn't work if you're unable to speak (silenced, gagged, underwater, and the like).
The phrase grows more specific - a full sentence, verse, or exact wording - long and distinct enough that garbling or rushing it fails the activation outright.
Two or more Gifts each require their own spoken incantation to activate.
Every Gift you have requires its own spoken incantation - none of your capability works if you can't speak clearly.

As Level 4, and the incantation must be spoken clean, with no other exertion that Round - sprinting, grappling, or taking a hit while attempting one fails it outright, forcing you to start over next round.

flaws.flavour: It doesn't work if you can't say it. Something out there is listening for the specific words and it is not interested in what you meant. A hand over your mouth is enough to stop you. So is a room where being heard would be a disaster.

flaws.name: Item of Power
flaws.blurb: A Gift of yours lives, at least partly, in something you carry rather than in you - see [Item of Power](#item-of-power) below for the 5-level breakdown.

levels.effect: One specific Gift only works while you're in possession of a particular item - well-secured or hard to casually separate from you (a tattoo, an implant, something bonded to you), but losing it locks out that one Gift entirely until it's recovered.
As Level 1, but the item is a real, ordinary object - a ring, a blade, a pendant - that can be stolen, confiscated, or lost in a struggle like any other possession.
Two or more Gifts are bound to the same item instead of just one - losing it locks out everything tied to it at once.
Every Gift you have depends on retaining the item - lose it, and you're left with nothing but your ordinary Skills, Boons, and Attributes until it's recovered.

As Level 4, and the item itself is something genuinely easy to take, damage, or lose - not secured, not bonded, not hard to separate from you at all. Anyone who thinks to try has a real shot at disarming you completely.

flaws.flavour: What you can do isn't entirely in you. Some of it lives in an object - a ring, a coat, a beat-up guitar case - and objects get lost, stolen, confiscated and left in somebody else's car.

flaws.name: Lame
flaws.blurb: An old injury or condition took some of your mobility and kept it - see [Lame](#lame) below for the 5-level breakdown.

levels.effect: A minor limp or stiffness - noticeable, doesn't slow them down in any real way.
Reduced mobility that costs something under exertion - slower over distance, real effort on stairs or rough terrain.
A significant mobility loss - needs a cane, brace, or similar aid for anything beyond short, easy movement.
Severe impairment - mobility is a constant limiting factor; sustained or fast movement is difficult even with aids.
Effectively immobile without significant support - a wheelchair or equivalent, or unable to move under their own power at all in a fight or chase.

flaws.flavour: The distance hasn't changed. What it costs you has. Stairs are a decision. "It's not far" is something other people say. You get where you are going - you just get there later, and you pay for it that night.

flaws.name: Notable Appearance
flaws.blurb: Something about how you look draws stares and reactions - see [Notable Appearance](#notable-appearance) below for the 5-level breakdown.

levels.effect: A minor, easily-overlooked trait - noticed only on close attention, rarely commented on.
A distinctive feature that people notice and occasionally remark on, but doesn't follow them.
A memorable appearance that people recognize and remember on sight - recall and gossip travel with them.
A striking appearance that draws stares and comment everywhere, actively makes blending in impossible.
An unmistakable, singular appearance - described in wanted posters and rumors alike; anyone who's heard of them would recognize them on sight.

flaws.flavour: People remember you. Every time, whether that's useful or not. The witness description is never vague and the bartender never has to ask twice. You have never once been "some guy" and you never will be.

flaws.name: Notoriety
flaws.blurb: How widely, and how badly, you're known - see [Notoriety](#notoriety) below for the 5-level breakdown.

levels.effect: Known within a small local circle - a minor local bad reputation, occasional suspicion.
A known troublemaker within a community or subculture.
Regionally known for something bad - distrust follows them beyond their home turf.
Widely infamous - recognized and reviled by strangers regularly.
A notorious name nationwide or worldwide, actively shunned or targeted on reputation alone.

flaws.flavour: Your name gets to the room before you do, and it has already said something you would rather it hadn't. Some of what they heard is true. The rest has been improved in the retelling, and nobody is interested in your correction.

flaws.name: Overconfident
flaws.blurb: You underestimate danger, or overestimate yourself, and you do it consistently - see [Overconfident](#overconfident) below for the 5-level breakdown.

levels.effect: Occasionally shrugs off a real warning - rarely costs anything, mostly just talk.
Regularly takes on tasks slightly beyond them without checking first - real but recoverable setbacks.
You habitually dismiss genuine danger and sound advice, and it costs you, and sometimes your allies, real setbacks.
Reliably walks into situations that are clearly beyond them, refusing help or backup even when it's obviously needed.
Cannot recognize danger as danger until it's already too late - repeatedly puts themselves and others at serious risk through sheer refusal to see their own limits.

flaws.flavour: You have been right enough times to stop checking. That worked out beautifully, right up until the day it didn't, and you are not convinced that day counts. You will take the odds. You always take the odds.

flaws.name: Pariah
flaws.blurb:
People hold a specific prejudice against you. Name it with your GM.
What I have in mind is the kind this setting invented: visibly not human, known to carry a Gift, marked by something that happened and never explained. The ordinary human bigotries exist in this world too, because it is our world - but they are not what this Flaw is for.

levels.effect: A minor prejudice - occasional dirty looks, mild social friction, rarely any material consequence.
Real but limited discrimination - some doors are harder to open (served last, passed over for a room), but nothing blocks basic life.
Active, meaningful discrimination - regularly denied service, employment, or fair treatment; public spaces mean dealing with real hostility.
Systemic hostility - the prejudice has institutional teeth: denied legal protection, actively targeted by local authority, barred from whole industries or areas.
Widespread, violent hostility - openly hunted, attacked, or persecuted for what they are; public life is dangerous.

flaws.flavour: There is a category people drop you into on sight and nothing you do gets you out of it. Being polite doesn't. Being useful doesn't. Being right definitely doesn't. You stopped waiting for the room to come around a long time ago.

flaws.name: Reliance
flaws.blurb: Something you need - a compulsion, a substance, or a condition that has to be managed - see [Reliance](#reliance) below for the 5-level breakdown.

levels.effect: A minor compulsion or mild reaction - inconvenient, rarely costly. A nervous habit like nail-biting; a mild seasonal allergy; a harmless lucky ritual before anything risky.

A real pull or trigger that occasionally costs something. A gambling habit that drains resources; an allergy requiring real caution (shellfish, bee stings); a compulsive need for background noise or routine that disrupts focus when broken.

A genuine dependency that shapes daily life. Regular substance use requiring a fix on a schedule; a chronic condition needing daily management (insulin, medication); hoarding or obsessive behavior that actively strains relationships.

A severe dependency with real danger if unmet. Hard addiction with physical withdrawal symptoms; a severe, life-threatening allergy on exposure; a compulsion strong enough to override better judgment in the moment.

A life-controlling dependency. An addiction that incapacitates without regular access; a condition requiring constant, uninterruptible support to survive; a compulsion so absolute it defines every decision you make.

flaws.flavour: There is something you need, and the needing keeps its own schedule. It doesn't care what else is happening. It doesn't negotiate, it doesn't wait for a good moment, and it always collects.

flaws.name: Ritual Required
flaws.blurb: A Gift doesn't answer the instant it's reached for - it has to be called, coaxed, or earned each time - see [Ritual Required](#ritual-required) below for the 5-level breakdown.

levels.effect: One specific Gift requires a short ritual - roughly a minute of chanting, gestures, or preparation - before its first use each Scene. Once performed, that Gift stays primed and usable normally for the rest of the Scene.
The same Gift now requires that ritual before every single use, not just once per Scene - each activation costs the full minute of setup again.
The ritual itself grows heavier - roughly ten minutes, real focus required. Anything that would normally cause [Distracted](rules.md#distracted) interrupts it outright, forcing you to start over.
Every Gift you have requires the Level 3 ritual before its first use each Scene, not just one - priming your full capability takes real, dedicated time.
Every Gift requires the full ritual before every single use, with no priming grace at all - full setup, every time, for everything you can do.

flaws.flavour: It answers. It just doesn't answer immediately. There is a procedure - words, motions, something burned, something owed - and it takes as long as it takes. Nobody has ever kicked in a door at a convenient moment.

flaws.name: Secret
flaws.blurb: Something you badly don't want getting out - see [Secret](#secret) below for the 5-level breakdown.

levels.effect: An embarrassing detail - mildly damaging to reputation if it got out, nothing more.
A real secret - exposure would cost you something genuine: a relationship, a job, a bit of standing.
A serious secret - exposure would cause real, lasting damage to your life, or the lives of people you care about.
A dangerous secret - exposure invites real threats: legal jeopardy, violence, or being hunted by someone with the power to act on it.
A world-shaking secret - exposure would be catastrophic, reshaping your life entirely, or endangering far more than just you.

flaws.flavour: One fact. That is all it is. One fact, and an entire life built carefully around it staying where it is. You have gotten good at steering a conversation. You have gotten better at leaving the room.

flaws.name: Shaken Confidence
flaws.blurb: One specific humiliation took your footing in a room, and you never got it back - see [Shaken Confidence](#shaken-confidence) below for the 5-level breakdown.

levels.effect: A specific type of social situation (public speaking, a rivalry, one particular person) triggers a flicker of doubt - costs a beat, nothing more.
Real hesitation in that situation - a genuine, recoverable setback if pushed through anyway.
Active avoidance of that situation where possible; forced into it, performs at a real disadvantage.
The doubt bleeds into adjacent situations, not just the original trigger - a broader loss of confidence.
A pervasive, crippling lack of social self-assurance - even routine interactions carry real hesitation, not just the original trigger.

flaws.flavour: It happened once, in front of people who mattered, and some part of you never quite stood back up. Everyone else forgot about it years ago. You did not. You feel it in the room every time something similar starts.

flaws.name: Short Fuse
flaws.blurb: You anger fast, and everybody can tell - see [Short Fuse](#short-fuse) below for the 5-level breakdown.

levels.effect: Snaps at minor annoyances - sharp words, nothing lasting.
Loses composure under real provocation - says or does something they regret, with real (if recoverable) social cost.
Hard to talk down once provoked - regularly escalates situations that a calmer head could have defused.
A serious liability under pressure - provocation reliably leads to real damage: burned bridges, real consequences, sometimes violence.
You can't reliably control yourself once triggered - provocation regularly leads to serious harm, to relationships or to people, with real consequences you can't walk back.

flaws.flavour: The distance between the provocation and your response is a lot shorter than most people's. You are not proud of it. You have apologized for it. And the next time somebody says the wrong thing, you will be halfway through the response before you notice you started.

flaws.name: Soft-Hearted
flaws.blurb: You struggle to act against the vulnerable, even when it costs you - see [Soft-Hearted](#soft-hearted) below for the 5-level breakdown.

levels.effect: Hesitates for a moment before acting against someone clearly weaker or in distress - costs a beat, nothing more.
Actively looks for a way to avoid harming the vulnerable, even if it costs real effort or a worse outcome elsewhere.
Will take a genuine risk or loss rather than harm someone vulnerable - a real, recurring cost.
Cannot bring themselves to act against the vulnerable even when the stakes are severe - will let an opportunity or advantage slip away rather than cross that line.
Will actively endanger themselves or the mission to protect or spare someone vulnerable, every time, no exceptions.

flaws.flavour: You know what the smart move is. Everybody does. You have simply never been able to make yourself do it - not to somebody already down, already scared, already smaller than you. It has cost you, and you would do it the same way again.

flaws.name: Speech Impediment
flaws.blurb: A stutter, an accent, something that gets between you and being understood - see [Speech Impediment](#speech-impediment) below for the 5-level breakdown.

levels.effect: A mild, noticeable quirk (a stutter under stress, a thick accent) - rarely actually hampers being understood.
A real impediment that occasionally causes miscommunication or draws unwanted attention.
A significant impediment - regularly slows or garbles speech enough that real effort is needed to be understood.
A severe impediment - verbal communication is unreliable; often misunderstood or unable to get a full thought out under pressure.
Effectively unable to communicate verbally in any reliable way - must rely on writing, gestures, or another person to speak for them.

flaws.flavour: The thought is clear. It is fast, it is complete, and it is exactly right. Getting it out of your mouth is the part that isn't. You have watched people decide what you were going to say and then answer that instead.

items.name: Baseball bat
items.flavour: Ash or aluminium, thirty-odd inches. The aluminium ones ring when they connect.

items.name: Battle spear
items.flavour: A steel head on an ash shaft, taller than the person carrying it.

items.name: Bayonet
items.flavour: A blade built to clamp onto a rifle, used off it more often than on.

items.name: Black powder pistol
items.flavour: A single shot, loaded down the muzzle. Takes a minute and a steady hand.

items.name: Blowgun
items.flavour: A metre of hollow tube and a tin of darts.

items.name: Boomerang
items.flavour: Shaped hardwood, flat on one face. The kind that comes back is not the kind built for hunting.

items.name: Brass knuckles
items.flavour: Four finger holes cast in one piece. Illegal in more places than people assume.

items.name: Chain whip
items.flavour: Linked steel sections with a weight at the end, folded down to nothing in a pocket.

items.name: Chainsaw
items.flavour: Petrol, two-stroke, and loud enough that nothing in the building is unaware of you.

items.name: Combat knife
items.flavour: Seven inches, full tang, a blood groove nobody needs.

items.name: Compact pistol
items.flavour: Polymer frame, short barrel, built to sit under a jacket and be forgotten about.

items.name: Compound bow
items.flavour: Cams and cables. Holds most of the draw weight for you once it is back.

items.name: Crossbow
items.flavour: A bow lying on its side with a trigger. Slow to load and no harder to aim than a rifle.

items.name: Dart pistol
items.flavour: Compressed gas and a magazine of darts. Quiet, and obviously not a firearm up close.

items.name: Derringer
items.flavour: Two barrels, palm-sized. Meant for a range where missing is not the problem.

items.name: English longbow
items.flavour: Six feet of yew. Pulling it properly deforms the bones of anyone who does it for years.

items.name: Fists, feet
items.flavour: What everybody brings.

items.name: Flail
items.flavour: A head on a chain on a handle. Goes around a guard rather than through it.

items.name: Flare gun
items.flavour: Fat-barrelled, bright orange, loaded with something meant to be seen for miles.

items.name: Garrote
items.flavour: Wire between two handles, carried coiled in a pocket.

items.name: Glaive
items.flavour: A long single-edged blade on a shaft. Cuts at a distance most people misjudge.

items.name: Halberd
items.flavour: An axe, a spike and a hook on one pole, for three different problems.

items.name: Hand axe
items.flavour: A hatchet balanced to be thrown as well as swung.

items.name: Hand crossbow
items.flavour: A crossbow cut down to one hand. The draw weight comes down with it.

items.name: Harpoon gun
items.flavour: A barbed head on a line, fired from a stock. Built for things in water.

items.name: Hatchet
items.flavour: A camp axe. Splits kindling and is always to hand.

items.name: Heavy revolver
items.flavour: Six chambers, a barrel long enough to be a nuisance, and no jams.

items.name: Hunting rifle
items.flavour: Bolt action, wooden stock, a scope somebody sighted in years ago.

items.name: Javelin
items.flavour: A throwing spear, light, with the weight forward.

items.name: Kama
items.flavour: A short blade set at a right angle to the handle. It started as a rice knife.

items.name: Katana
items.flavour: A curved single edge, folded steel, a grip for one hand or two.

items.name: Kukri
items.flavour: A heavy forward-angled blade. Chops out of proportion to its size.

items.name: Mace
items.flavour: A flanged steel head on a short haft. Does not care what the armour is made of.

items.name: Machete
items.flavour: Eighteen inches of soft steel. Cheap, everywhere, and sharpened on a stone.

items.name: Metal pipe
items.flavour: A length of scaffold or plumbing, picked up on the way past.

items.name: Muzzleloader rifle
items.flavour: Powder, ball and ramrod. One shot and then a long wait.

items.name: Nail gun
items.flavour: Pneumatic, framing weight, with the safety nose removed by somebody.

items.name: Net launcher
items.flavour: A weighted net in a compressed-gas launcher. Opens in the air.

items.name: Nunchaku
items.flavour: Two hardwood batons on a short chain.

items.name: Pump shotgun
items.flavour: Twelve gauge, tube magazine, the sound of the action doing half the work.

items.name: Rapier
items.flavour: A long narrow blade with a cage over the hand. Built entirely around the point.

items.name: Recurve bow
items.flavour: Limbs curving away at the tips. Takedown, so it travels in a bag.

items.name: Revolver rifle
items.flavour: A cylinder in a rifle stock. Rare, and it spits at the wrist that holds it.

items.name: Sai
items.flavour: A blunt spike with two side prongs, carried in pairs. Built to trap a blade.

items.name: Sap
items.flavour: Lead shot in a leather pouch, flat enough for a back pocket.

items.name: Sawed-off shotgun
items.flavour: Both barrels cut back to nothing. Fits under a coat and spreads immediately.

items.name: Service pistol
items.flavour: Full-size automatic, fifteen rounds, what a duty holster is shaped for.

items.name: Short sword
items.flavour: Two feet of straight double edge. Indoors it beats anything longer.

items.name: Sledgehammer
items.flavour: Ten pounds on a hickory handle. Meant for masonry.

items.name: Sling
items.flavour: A leather cradle and two cords. Older than everything else on this page.

items.name: Snub-nose revolver
items.flavour: Five rounds, two-inch barrel, no hammer spur to catch on a pocket.

items.name: Speargun
items.flavour: Rubber bands and a steel shaft. Works properly only underwater.

items.name: Switchblade
items.flavour: Four inches, spring-loaded, opens with a thumb.

items.name: Tactical carbine
items.flavour: Short-barrelled semi-auto, adjustable stock, rails for whatever you bolt to it.

items.name: Throwing knife
items.flavour: No edge worth speaking of. All of it is balance.

items.name: Tonfa
items.flavour: A baton with a side handle. Guards the forearm as well as it strikes.

items.name: Tranquilizer rifle
items.flavour: A single dart on compressed gas. The dose is a guess and the wait is worse.

items.name: Trench knife
items.flavour: A blade with knuckles built into the grip. Exactly as old as the name suggests.

items.name: Two-handed sword
items.flavour: Five feet of it, and a grip long enough to need both hands honestly.

items.name: War axe
items.flavour: A bearded head on a two-foot haft. The beard is for pulling shields down.

items.name: War fan
items.flavour: Steel ribs in a folding fan. Closed it is a baton, open it is a guard.

items.name: Warhammer
items.flavour: A hammer face one side, a spike the other, on a long haft.

items.name: Whip
items.flavour: Twelve feet of plaited leather. Everything it does is at the tip.

items.Notes: Reads as clothing; no penalty

items.name: Armored suit lining
items.flavour: Soft panels tailored into a two-piece. Somebody was paid well to make it hang right.

items.Notes: Worn over or under clothing; no penalty

items.name: Tactical flashlight
items.flavour: Anodised aluminium, a tail switch, and bright enough to be an argument.

items.Effect: Field shelter for one to two; lighter and cheaper than the full Tent & sleeping gear kit
items.name: Tent
items.flavour: Two-person, three-season, and the poles are colour-coded for a reason.

items.Effect: Field shelter; avoids Exhausted accrual from a rough night outdoors
items.name: Tent & sleeping gear
items.flavour: The tent, a bag rated lower than you need, and a mat that will deflate by morning.

items.Effect: Consumed on use: burns through a locked or reinforced barrier, no roll needed - GM's call on collateral
items.name: Thermite charge
items.flavour: A shaped canister with an igniter. Burns through what it is sat on.

items.Effect: Makes seawater safe to drink, no roll
items.name: Water desalinator
items.flavour: A hand-pumped reverse osmosis unit. Slow, and heavier than the brochure said.

items.Effect: Required tool for metal-cutting or joining tasks; without one, at Disadvantage
items.name: Welding torch
items.flavour: Oxy-acetylene on a trolley, with a striker on a chain.

items.Effect: Consumed on use: clears one Exhausted level instantly and negates a severe allergic reaction, no roll
items.name: Adrenaline shot (epi-pen)
items.flavour: An auto-injector in a plastic tube. Blue to the sky, orange to the thigh.

items.Effect: Consumed on use: Advantage on treating Health Levels, usable even to stabilize someone at or below 0
items.name: Advanced trauma kit
items.flavour: A vacuum-packed roll of tourniquets, chest seals, airways and packing gauze.

items.Effect: Consumed on use: ends Envenomed from the venom it's made for
items.name: Antitoxin
items.flavour: A vial and a syringe in a cold pack, with the venom it answers written on the label.

items.Effect: Consumed on use: Advantage on treating a burn injury specifically
items.name: Burn gel / dressing
items.flavour: Sterile gel-soaked pads in foil, sized from a hand to a torso.

items.Effect: Required tool for identifying unknown substances; Advantage on related Research/Science rolls
items.name: Chemical analysis kit
items.flavour: Reagent bottles, a spot plate and a card of colour references.

items.Effect: Consumed on use: can revive a target from Unconscious at 0 Health Levels, no roll, if used within the same Scene they went down
items.name: Defibrillator (AED)
items.flavour: A hard case with two pads and a voice that talks you through it.

items.Effect: A case that performs surgery. Better than a paramedic, worse than a surgeon, and it never panics.
items.name: Field autodoc
items.flavour: A case that opens into a frame over a patient, with arms that do the work themselves.

items.Effect: Consumed on use: clear your current Exhausted levels, or grant Advantage on one Physical roll - GM's call on any crash afterward
items.name: Field stimulant
items.flavour: Ampoules in a foam block. Whatever is in them is not sold over a counter.

items.Effect: Consumed on use: Advantage on treating Exhausted levels or blood loss
items.name: IV kit & fluids
items.flavour: Bags of saline, giving sets, cannulas and a length of tape.

items.Effect: Handheld. Sees the break, the bleed and the poison without opening anything.
items.name: Medical scanner
items.flavour: A handheld unit run over a patient, reading out more than a pulse.

items.Effect: Consumed on use: reverses an opioid overdose outright, no roll
items.name: Naloxone kit
items.flavour: Two doses of nasal spray in a hard case, with the instructions printed on the lid.

items.Effect: Required tool for field-splinting a broken limb; without one, at Disadvantage
items.name: SAM splint
items.flavour: A rolled aluminium and foam strip, bent to shape around a limb.

items.Effect: Ranged; a target Overwhelmed by its Stamina-based dice falls Unconscious instead of just losing Health Levels (GM's call on framing)
items.name: Sedative dart
items.flavour: A single dart with a pressurised chamber behind the needle.

items.Effect: Buys you a night. You pay for it over the following week.
items.name: Stimulant patch
items.flavour: An adhesive patch that goes on the neck and works through the skin.

items.Effect: Required tool for treatment beyond field first aid; without one, at Disadvantage on major Health Level treatment
items.name: Surgical kit
items.flavour: A sterile roll of scalpels, forceps, clamps, needles and suture.

items.Effect: Consumed on use: Advantage on the next roll to treat Health Levels lost to a bleeding injury
items.name: Tourniquet
items.flavour: A windlass on a webbing strap, one-handed by design.

items.Effect: Adhesive. Stops the bleeding and the panic for about an hour; buys time, not recovery.
items.name: Trauma patch
items.flavour: A sealed dressing with a clotting agent already in the gauze.

items.Effect: No roll to quickly cut through clothing or restraints to treat an injury
items.name: Trauma shears
items.flavour: Angled shears that cut a boot off without touching what is inside it.

items.Effect: Makes questionable water safe to drink, no roll - lighter than a full purifier
items.name: Water purification tablets
items.flavour: A strip of foil-wrapped tablets. Thirty minutes and it tastes of a swimming pool.

items.Effect: Advantage on Lockpicking rolls against standard pin-tumbler locks
items.name: Bump key set
items.flavour: Filed-down blanks in the common profiles, and a plastic mallet to tap them.

items.Effect: Destroys everything inside it in under a minute, unrecoverably
items.name: Burn bag
items.flavour: A lined sack with a pull igniter in the seam. Everything in it goes to ash.

items.Effect: A rifle that comes apart into something that reads as an instrument case.
items.name: Collapsible rifle case
items.flavour: A padded case that breaks down into something a tennis racket would fit in.

items.Effect: Defeats a description or ID check based on eye color, no roll
items.name: Colored contact lenses
items.flavour: Tinted soft lenses in a case, in three shades nobody would remark on.

items.Effect: A prepared spot nobody watches. Hand something over without meeting anybody
items.name: Dead drop cache
items.flavour: A weatherproof tube and a spot nobody watches. The spot is the expensive part.

items.Effect: Advantage on Deception rolls involving a physical disguise
items.name: Disguise kit
items.flavour: Spirit gum, pigments, brushes, appliances and a mirror that folds flat.

items.Effect: Untraceable, disposable comms; discard after use to leave no trail
items.name: Encrypted burner phone
items.flavour: A cheap handset with an encrypted messenger on it, bought for cash.

items.Effect: Advantage on Stealth rolls in matching terrain
items.name: Environment-matched camo
items.flavour: A pattern chosen for one specific place, not a general-purpose one.

items.Effect: Leaves no fingerprints; negates related forensic Investigation against the wearer
items.name: Fingerprint gloves
items.flavour: Thin nitrile with textured pads. Leaves marks that are nobody’s.

items.Effect: Advantage on Stealth rolls in matching natural terrain (doesn't stack with Environment-matched camo)
items.name: Ghillie suit
items.flavour: A net oversuit hung with jute garnish, tied on in handfuls over weeks.

items.Effect: Advantage on Climbing rolls on sheer or smooth surfaces
items.name: Grapple gloves
items.flavour: Gloves with a launcher on the back of each wrist and a spool in the cuff.

items.Effect: Advantage on Deception rolls impersonating a specific known individual
items.name: Prosthetic scars / tattoo kit
items.flavour: Silicone appliances, transfer inks and remover, in a flat tin.

items.Effect: Advantage on Deception rolls passing as a specific role or organization while worn
items.name: Uniform disguise
items.flavour: Somebody’s actual work clothes, with the right boots and a laminated card.

items.Effect: Advantage on Investigation rolls at a scene with UV-reactive evidence
items.name: UV flashlight
items.flavour: A torch throwing almost nothing visible. Things on a floor light up under it.

items.Effect: Advantage on Deception rolls made over a phone or radio specifically
items.name: Voice changer
items.flavour: An inline unit between a handset and an earpiece, with a dial.

items.Effect: Advantage on Deception rolls for a full appearance change (doesn't stack with a Face-changing prosthetics kit)
items.name: Wig & makeup kit
items.flavour: Two wigs on blocks, pins, and a case of everything to go with them.

items.Effect: Advantage on Perception rolls at Far range
items.name: Binoculars
items.flavour: Roof prism, ten by forty-two, rubber armoured.

items.Effect: Covert audio pickup, Close-Near broadcast range
items.name: Concealable microphone
items.flavour: A microphone the size of a shirt button on a hair-thin lead.

items.Effect: Advantage on eavesdropping at Near-Far range
items.name: Directional microphone
items.flavour: A shotgun mic in a foam windshield, on a pistol grip.

items.Effect: Covert visual feed, live or for later retrieval
items.name: Hidden camera
items.flavour: A pinhole lens built into something ordinary, with a card slot in the back of it.

items.Effect: Ranged; attaches a Covert GPS tracker to a target or vehicle without them noticing (Stealth vs. Perception)
items.name: Hidden tracker dart
items.flavour: A tracker in a dart body, fired from a gas launcher and sticky on impact.

items.Effect: Advantage on eavesdropping at Far range specifically (line of sight required)
items.name: Parabolic microphone
items.flavour: A clear plastic dish with a microphone at the focus and headphones on a lead.

items.Effect: Advantage on Perception rolls made specifically to find a hidden microphone or tracker
items.name: RF / bug detector
items.flavour: A wand with a meter on it, swept slowly along a wall.

items.Effect: Comms and data access with no signal dependency, works anywhere - a team-wide version of a Satellite phone
items.name: Satellite uplink
items.flavour: A folding dish in a hard case, with a terminal that takes ten minutes to find the sky.

items.Effect: Covert visual recording, easily overlooked as an everyday object
items.name: Spy pen camera
items.flavour: A pen that writes, with a lens above the clip.

items.Effect: Insect-sized. Flies in through the gap a window was left open and sends back what it sees.
items.name: Surveillance microdrone
items.flavour: Insect-sized. Flies in through the gap a window was left open and sends back what it sees.

items.Effect: Unattended, motion-triggered; monitors a fixed location indefinitely
items.name: Trail camera
items.flavour: A camouflaged box strapped to a tree, motion-triggered, with infrared for night.

items.Notes: Road to water without stopping. Neither half is best in class.
items.name: Amphibious conversion vehicle
items.flavour: A four-wheel-drive with a sealed hull, a propeller and seams that need checking.

items.Notes: Advantage on Chase rolls off-road; not street-legal
items.name: ATV / dirt bike
items.flavour: Knobbly tyres, long travel suspension, and no interest in roads.

items.Notes: Quiet, no fuel, no roll to operate
items.name: Bicycle
items.flavour: A bike. Quiet, cheap, and it goes where cars cannot.

items.Notes: Hauling capacity, inconspicuous
items.name: Cargo van
items.flavour: White, high roof, no windows in the back. Nobody looks at it twice.

items.Notes: Ordinary car, 4-5 seats
items.name: Economy sedan
items.flavour: Four doors, grey, ten years old. The most invisible object on this page.

items.Notes: Will not fall over. Will still throw you off.
items.name: Gyro-stabilized superbike
items.flavour: A litre bike with active stabilisation. Stays upright doing things that should not.

items.Notes: Unpowered gliding flight from height, requires Piloting
items.name: Hang glider / wingsuit
items.flavour: A wing in a bag, or a suit with webbing between the limbs. Both are one-way.

items.Notes: Ordinary mount, no fuel required
items.name: Horse & tack
items.flavour: A horse, a saddle, a bridle and the knowledge of how to use all three.

items.Notes: Slow vertical/wind-drift flight, requires Piloting
items.name: Hot air balloon
items.flavour: An envelope, a basket, burners and a truck to collect you afterwards.

items.Notes: Water only, human-powered
items.name: Kayak / canoe
items.flavour: A hull, a paddle and a spray deck. Portable if two people are willing.

items.Notes: Full 3D movement, requires Piloting
items.name: Light helicopter
items.flavour: A four-seat turbine. Needs somewhere flat and everybody knowing you have arrived.

items.Notes: Full underwater movement, requires Piloting
items.name: Mini-submarine
items.flavour: A two-person hull with a battery bank, viewports and eight hours of air.

items.Notes: A house that leaves, and a jurisdiction you choose.
items.name: Motor yacht
items.flavour: Forty feet, twin diesels, berths for six and a tender on the back.

items.Notes: Advantage on Chase rolls in dense urban/congested terrain
items.name: Motorcycle
items.flavour: Six hundred cubic centimetres of it, and it fits through traffic.

items.Notes: Advantage on Chase rolls off-road or rough terrain
items.name: Off-road SUV
items.flavour: Body on frame, locking differentials, and tyres that hum on tarmac.

items.Notes: Safe descent from height or an aircraft; single-use per jump unless repacked
items.name: Parachute
items.flavour: A ram-air canopy, harness, reserve and an automatic opener nobody argues with.

items.Notes: Water only, Advantage on Chase rolls on open water
items.name: Personal watercraft
items.flavour: A jet-drive ski for two, fast in a straight line and no use in a swell.

items.Notes: Real cargo/towing capacity
items.name: Pickup truck
items.flavour: A bed, a tow hitch, and a cab that seats three at a push.

items.Notes: Range, privacy, and a crew who know your name.
items.name: Private jet
items.flavour: Light twin, six seats, and a crew who have been told not to file a passenger list.

items.Notes: Quiet, no fuel, folds for easy carry
items.name: Skateboard / scooter
items.flavour: Board or kick scooter. Goes under an arm at the door.

items.Notes: Snow or ice only, requires a team of sled dogs
items.name: Sled / dog sled
items.flavour: A basket sled, a gangline and a team who know the route better than you do.

items.Notes: Requires Piloting (Fixed-Wing)
items.name: Small fixed-wing aircraft
items.flavour: Four seats, one engine, and a strip short enough to be unofficial.

items.Notes: Water only
items.name: Speedboat
items.flavour: An open hull with far too much outboard on the back of it.

items.Notes: Fast, loud, and remembered by everyone who saw it.
items.name: Supercar
items.flavour: Mid-engined, carbon, and every camera on the route will remember it.

items.Notes: Real cargo capacity, requires a towing vehicle
items.name: Utility trailer
items.flavour: A flatbed on a tow ball, with a ramp and a tarpaulin.

items.Effect: Same as pepper spray, but a Close-range cone hitting everyone in it
items.name: Bear spray
items.flavour: A fire-extinguisher-sized canister with a safety clip and a belt holster.

items.Effect: Blinded for 1 round, no roll needed to trigger
items.name: Blinding strobe
items.flavour: A handheld lamp that pulses hard enough to be felt behind the eyes.

items.Effect: Target's Movement Rate is halved until they break free
items.name: Bola
items.flavour: Three weights on cords, spun and let go.

items.name: Collapsible baton
items.flavour: Telescoping steel, twenty-one inches out, flicked open with a wrist.

items.Effect: Everyone in a Close radius is Blinded and at Disadvantage for 1 round
items.name: Flashbang
items.flavour: A perforated steel body. Light and pressure, no fragments.

items.Effect: Restrains a compliant or already-subdued target; cut, not unlocked
items.name: Flex cuffs
items.flavour: Heavy zip ties, doubled, cut off rather than unlocked.

items.Effect: Restrains whoever triggers it
items.name: Grappling snare
items.flavour: A spring-loaded loop on a ground plate, set and covered over.

items.Effect: Restrains a compliant or already-subdued target until unlocked
items.name: Handcuffs
items.flavour: Chain-linked steel, double locked with the tip of the key.

items.Effect: No Health Level loss from this weapon alone; Prone and Disadvantage next turn
items.name: Less-lethal shotgun (beanbag)
items.flavour: A shotgun with an orange stock, so nobody loads it wrong in a hurry.

items.Effect: Target is Restrained until they break free (Potence check)
items.name: Net gun
items.flavour: A weighted net folded into four barrels, fired by compressed gas.

items.Effect: Blinded and Disadvantage on all rolls for 1 round
items.name: Pepper spray
items.flavour: A keyring canister with a flip cover, a stream rather than a mist.

items.Effect: Same Blinded effect as pepper spray, less blowback risk
items.name: Pepper spray gel
items.flavour: A thicker formulation that goes where it is aimed and stays there.

items.Effect: Same as the beanbag shotgun above
items.name: Rubber bullet launcher
items.flavour: A break-action launcher with a wide bore and a padded stock.

items.Effect: Target is Stunned until the start of their next turn
items.name: Shock baton
items.flavour: A baton with contacts at the tip and a trigger under the thumb.

items.Effect: Prone, can't act until the start of their next turn
items.name: Shock dart gun
items.flavour: A blocky handgun firing two barbs on wires, with a cartridge in the nose.

items.Effect: Fills a Close radius with concealment; Advantage on Stealth to break contact
items.name: Smoke grenade
items.flavour: A canister that burns rather than bursts, throwing smoke for a minute.

items.Effect: Disadvantage on all rolls while in the cone
items.name: Sonic deterrent device
items.flavour: A dish on a handle, projecting a tone in a cone in front of it.

items.Effect: Disadvantage on the target's next roll
items.name: Stun gun
items.flavour: Two contacts and a trigger. It has to be touching to do anything.

items.Effect: Everyone in a Close radius is Blinded and at Disadvantage until they leave the area
items.name: Tear gas grenade
items.flavour: A burning canister, hot enough that picking it up to throw back costs something.

items.Effect: A vial. Burns what should not be touching a person, and marks a line nothing crosses unnoticed
items.name: Blessed water
items.flavour: A vial of water out of a font, stoppered and sealed with wax. It looks like water.

items.Effect: Rosemary, lavender, juniper or mugwort, dried and bound. The smoke clears a room of what has been lingering in it
items.name: Cleansing bundle
items.flavour: Rosemary, lavender, juniper or mugwort, dried and bound with cotton thread.

items.Effect: Anoints a person, a door or a blade. Lasts the night
items.name: Consecrated oil
items.flavour: Olive oil in a small glass bottle, blessed and left to stand a week.

items.Effect: A jar. Taken with permission, which is the difficult part
items.name: Graveyard dirt
items.flavour: A jam jar of soil taken off a grave.

items.Effect: Brass on a chain, and a box of cones. Reusable
items.name: Incense and censer
items.flavour: A pierced brass bowl on three chains, and a box of cones.

items.Effect: A pound. Mixed into paint, scattered on a sill, or thrown
items.name: Iron filings
items.flavour: A pound of iron swarf in a tin. It rusts if the lid is left off.

items.Effect: A dozen. Burn for six hours and go out together whatever is left of them
items.name: Ritual candles
items.flavour: A dozen plain candles, unscented, wicks already trimmed.

items.Effect: Draws on anything, and does not come off until you take it off
items.name: Ritual chalk
items.flavour: A box of soft white sticks. They mark anything, including things chalk should not mark.

items.Effect: Pre-measured salt, a cord and chalk in a tin. One complete circle
items.name: Salt circle kit
items.flavour: A tin holding measured salt, a length of cord and a stick of chalk.

items.Effect: Enough for a circle around one room, or a line across four doorways
items.name: Salt, canister
items.flavour: A cardboard canister of coarse salt. The cheap kind, off a supermarket shelf.

items.Effect: A vial. Puts silver where silver would not otherwise reach
items.name: Silver dust
items.flavour: A vial of silver ground finer than flour.

items.Effect: Spray or brush. One room's worth of sigils
items.name: Warding paint
items.flavour: A rattle can, or a brush and a tin. Both work.

items.Effect: Silver, unmarked, waiting for a ritual to put something in it
items.name: Blank amulet
items.flavour: A flat silver disc on a cord, unmarked on both faces.

items.Effect: Cloth and a drawstring, filled to purpose. Carried, not hung
items.name: Charm bag
items.flavour: A cloth bag the size of a plum, drawstring at the neck.

items.Effect: Hand-forged rather than drawn. Driven into a threshold, or carried
items.name: Cold iron nail
items.flavour: A hand-forged nail, black, square in section. Drawn wire will not do.

items.Effect: A piece of a church bell. Rare, and nobody who has one sells it cheaply
items.name: Consecrated iron fragment
items.flavour: A shard off a church bell, thumb-sized and still curved.

items.Effect: Blue glass or enamel. Worn where it can be seen, which is the point
items.name: Evil eye charm
items.flavour: Blue glass with a white and black eye in the middle. Sold on every market stall on the Mediterranean.

items.Effect: A pebble with a hole worn through it. Hung over a bed on red ribbon, nothing sits on the sleeper's chest
items.name: Hag stone
items.flavour: A beach pebble with a hole worn through it by water. The hole has to be natural.

items.Effect: Cold iron, hand-forged. What they hold cannot simply stop being solid
items.name: Iron handcuffs
items.flavour: Hand-forged cuffs, heavier than police issue, with a key that fits nothing else.

items.Effect: Over a door, open end up. Everybody's grandmother had one
items.name: Iron horseshoe
items.flavour: A used shoe off a working horse, nail holes and all.

items.Effect: Nine knots tied in order. Untie them one at a time and one at a time only
items.name: Knotted cord
items.flavour: A yard of cord with nine knots along it.

items.Effect: A rowan cross bound in red. Over a door, or on a person
items.name: Rowan and red thread
items.flavour: Two rowan twigs bound into a cross with red wool.

items.Effect: Dried rue in linen. Worn against the evil eye
items.name: Rue sachet
items.flavour: Dried rue in a linen bag, stitched shut.

items.Effect: Chalk, salt, iron and cord in a roll. One doorway, complete
items.name: Threshold ward kit
items.flavour: A canvas roll holding chalk, salt, iron filings and cord.

items.Effect: Glass, sealed, full of pins and worse. Buried at a threshold, it takes what was meant for you
items.name: Witch bottle
items.flavour: A glass bottle of pins, nail clippings and worse, sealed with wax.

items.Effect: A box of twenty
items.name: Blessed rounds
items.flavour: A box of twenty, each round blessed before it was loaded.

items.Effect: A box of twenty
items.name: Cold iron rounds
items.flavour: A box of twenty, cast from wrought iron rather than lead. They foul a barrel.

items.Effect: Ten shells. Hurts enormously, kills nothing
items.name: Salt-loaded shells
items.flavour: Ten shotgun shells packed with rock salt in place of shot.

items.Effect: Ten shells
items.name: Silver buckshot
items.flavour: Ten shells loaded with cast silver balls.

items.Effect: A box of twenty, cast rather than plated
items.name: Silver rounds
items.flavour: A box of twenty, cast solid rather than plated.

items.Effect: Scans the band without stopping. People hear words in it
items.name: Audio sweep radio
items.flavour: A radio modified to sweep the band without stopping.

items.Effect: Records the room, and sometimes more of it than was there
items.name: Digital voice recorder
items.flavour: A pocket recorder with a better microphone than it needs.

items.Effect: Two brass L-rods. They move. Nobody agrees why
items.name: Dowsing rods
items.flavour: Two brass rods bent into L shapes, held loose in the fists.

items.Effect: Reads electromagnetic fields. What that means is between you and your GM
items.name: EMF meter
items.flavour: A handheld meter with a needle and five LEDs above it.

items.Effect: Stills and video, into ultraviolet and infrared
items.name: Full-spectrum camera
items.flavour: A camera with the infrared filter taken out of it.

items.Effect: Surface temperature at a distance, to a tenth of a degree
items.name: Infrared thermometer
items.flavour: A pistol-grip thermometer with a laser dot on the front.

items.Effect: Swabs, vials, a UV lamp and evidence bags
items.name: Residue sample kit
items.flavour: Swabs, vials, a UV lamp and a box of evidence bags.

items.Notes: Grounds, staff, and enough distance that nobody hears anything. Name it as your repository and anything you own but are not carrying is in it. Somebody on the staff knows where, which is either convenient or a problem.
items.name: Estate
items.flavour: A house with a name rather than a number, at the end of a drive nobody turns down by accident.

items.Notes: An address in nobody's name that nobody visits, kitted out and stocked for as long as you need to be there. Name it as your repository and anything you own but are not carrying is in it, rather than somewhere nobody has decided yet.
items.name: Safe house (urban)
items.flavour: A flat on a middle floor, rented under a company, with the bills paid by standing order.

items.Notes: Movement Rate -4; Disadvantage on all Physical rolls except resisting damage
items.name: Bomb disposal suit
items.flavour: Ninety pounds of layered aramid and plate, with a fan in the helmet and a wire to a controller.

items.Notes: Worn under a jacket, no penalty; survives a glance, not a pat-down
items.name: Covert plate vest
items.flavour: Thin rifle plates in a carrier cut to vanish under a jacket, bought from a man who does not ask what size you are.

items.name: Anti-materiel rifle
items.flavour: Fifty calibre, a bipod, and a muzzle brake that hurts everyone nearby more than the shooter.

items.name: Compact SMG
items.flavour: A folding stock and a thirty-round magazine in a package the size of a laptop.

items.name: Concealed wrist blades
items.flavour: Spring blades in forearm sheaths, released by turning the wrist against a catch.

items.name: Grenade launcher
items.flavour: Single shot, break action, a fat forty-millimetre bore and a ladder sight.

items.name: Gyrojet pistol
items.flavour: Fires rocket rounds rather than bullets. Harmless up close and unpleasant at distance.

items.name: Monofilament blade
items.flavour: A handle with nothing coming out of it until the light catches the line. It is all edge.

items.name: Monofilament garrote
items.flavour: The same filament between two handles, on a spool in a cigarette packet.

items.name: Squad automatic weapon
items.flavour: Belt-fed, bipod, a spare barrel in a bag because you will need it.

items.Effect: Advantage on bypassing keycard/RFID-secured locks specifically
items.name: RFID cloner
items.flavour: A reader and a writer in one case, with a stack of blank fobs.

items.Effect: Consumed on use: removes DNA evidence from a scene, no roll
items.name: DNA-scrubbing wipes
items.flavour: Foil sachets of enzyme wipes that leave a surface less clean than empty.

items.Effect: Required tool for cracking a combination safe; without one, at Disadvantage
items.name: Safecracking kit
items.flavour: An autodialler, a borescope, a magnetic mount and a great deal of patience.

items.Effect: Advantage on Deception rolls sustained over a longer con (doesn't stack with a Wig & makeup kit)
items.name: Face-changing prosthetics kit
items.flavour: Cast silicone appliances, adhesive and pigments, keyed to one specific face.

items.Effect: Passes routine authority checks with no roll; GM's call under real scrutiny
items.name: Forged badge / credentials
items.flavour: A badge and a card wallet, correct down to the holographic overlay.

items.Effect: Passes routine identity checks with no roll; GM's call under real scrutiny
items.name: Forged documents
items.flavour: Passport, licence and supporting paper, made by somebody who checks their own work.

items.Effect: Advantage on eavesdropping at Far range, wider coverage than a handheld Parabolic microphone
items.name: Long-range parabolic dish
items.flavour: A metre of dish on a tripod, with a preamp and a recorder in the case.

items.Effect: Reads conversation through a window via glass vibration, no physical entry needed
items.name: Laser listening device
items.flavour: A laser and a receiver on a tripod, aimed at a windowpane from across the street.

items.Effect: Required tool for tapping a landline or network line; without one, at Disadvantage
items.name: Wiretap kit
items.flavour: Alligator clips, a recorder and a lineman’s handset in a battered bag.

items.Effect: Advantage on Investigation rolls to identify a known individual from a photo or footage
items.name: Facial recognition tablet
items.flavour: A tablet with a camera and a database on it that nobody is supposed to have.

items.Effect: Advantage on forced-entry rolls; treat your Potence as +2 for that Break Threshold check
items.name: Breaching kit
items.flavour: A hooligan bar, a hydraulic ram, cutting charges and hearing protection.

items.Effect: Anchored lines and powered reels. Turns a city into handholds.
items.name: Wire ascent rig
items.flavour: A powered ascender that climbs a fixed line faster than a person can.

items.Effect: Disables nearby camera feeds within Close range
items.name: Camera jammer
items.flavour: A box that fills a camera’s sensor with light nobody in the room can see.

items.Effect: Armed and airborne. Illegal in every jurisdiction that has noticed it exists.
items.name: Combat drone (rotor)
items.flavour: A quadcopter with a weapon mount under it and armour over the motors.

items.Effect: Required tool for certain rapid digital-copy Hacking tasks
items.name: Data cloner
items.flavour: A write-blocked duplicator that takes a drive image and leaves no timestamps behind.

items.Effect: One-time consumable; disables nearby unshielded electronics within Close range
items.name: EMP device
items.flavour: A capacitor bank and a coil in a flight case. One shot, and then it is scrap too.

items.Effect: Disables GPS tracking on anyone/anything within Close range
items.name: GPS jammer
items.flavour: A cigarette packet with an aerial, putting noise across the satellite band.

items.Effect: A purpose-built machine for being somewhere you have no account. Advantage on Systems Operation against a defended system.
items.name: Intrusion deck
items.flavour: A purpose-built machine with its own radios and an operating system nobody sells.

items.Effect: Disables nearby wireless comms/cameras within Near range - wider coverage than a Signal jammer
items.name: Portable jammer array
items.flavour: Four transmitters on stands, covering everything from a room to a street.

items.Effect: Advantage cloning or bypassing RFID-secured credentials
items.name: RFID skimmer
items.flavour: A reader in a satchel, picking up cards through a coat at walking distance.

items.Effect: Disables nearby wireless comms/cameras within Close range
items.name: Signal jammer
items.flavour: A handheld unit with three stubby aerials and a bank of switches.

items.Effect: Advantage locating the source of a specific radio or wireless signal
items.name: Signal triangulator
items.flavour: Three receivers and a tablet, drawing a shrinking circle around a transmitter.

items.Notes: Hardness 4, 3 Health Levels (executive-protection grade)
items.name: Armored sedan
items.flavour: A factory car with the doors, pillars and glass replaced. It sits low on its springs.

items.Notes: Hardness 6, 4 Health Levels (per the materials table), several passengers ride behind that Hardness
items.name: Armored transport van
items.flavour: A cash-in-transit van with gun ports and a door nobody opens from outside.

items.Notes: Hardness 7, 5 Health Levels (per the materials table), several passengers ride behind that Hardness
items.name: Armored personnel carrier
items.flavour: Eight wheels, a hull, and no explaining it to anybody who sees it.

items.Notes: A projected barrier on a worn rig; spent for the Scene once its Health Levels are gone
items.name: Ablative shield harness
items.flavour: A harness of emitter pods that throws a shell which burns away as it is hit.

items.Notes: Single item, sets all four Zones; carried as a hard case, a Slow action to climb into, a Normal action to shed; Movement Rate -1
items.name: Deployable armor case
items.flavour: A hard-shell case the size of carry-on luggage that unfolds around you, plate by plate, and seals at the throat.

items.Notes: Each time it loses a Health Level it blows outward: everyone else in Melee range takes 1 die against Soak; Disadvantage on Stealth rolls
items.name: Reactive plate vest
items.flavour: Tiles of explosive laminate over a steel back plate. It stops the round by throwing itself at it.

items.Notes: Soft as cloth until it's struck; reads as clothing, no penalty
items.name: Shear-thickening suit
items.flavour: A suit of ordinary-looking cloth soaked in a fluid that goes hard as stone the instant anything hits it.

items.name: Energy rifle
items.flavour: A rifle with no chamber and no brass, drawing from a cell in the stock.

items.Notes: Vertical takeoff, four seats, and a landing fee everywhere worth landing.
items.name: Aerodyne (flying car)
items.flavour: A car-sized airframe on ducted fans, with doors and a boot like anything else.

items.Notes: You go in ruined and come out months of healing later, in days.
items.name: Bio-regeneration tank
items.flavour: A filled cylinder with a lid, a pump stack and a body suspended inside it.

items.Notes: Records an experience whole - sight, sound, and what it felt like to be there.
items.name: Braindance recorder
items.flavour: A headset that records everything a person saw, heard and felt, for somebody else to wear.

items.Notes: Minutes of flight, deafening, and it lands harder than it takes off.
items.name: Jet pack
items.flavour: Two ducted fans on a frame, with a harness and about ninety seconds of fuel.

items.Notes: Injected machines that close what surgery would have to open you for.
items.name: Nanite repair kit
items.flavour: An ampoule of grey fluid and an applicator. It works on the machine, not the pilot.

items.Notes: Bends light around the wearer. Works until you move quickly.
items.name: Optical camouflage cloak
items.flavour: A weighted cloak that shows whatever is behind it, a half-second late.

items.Notes: A room-sized autodoc. Handles what the field case cannot.
items.name: Surgical pod
items.flavour: An enclosed table with arms above it, which does not need anybody in the room.

items.Notes: Excavated, powered, and on no plan ever filed with the city.
items.name: Underground facility
items.flavour: Excavated, powered, and on no plan ever filed with the city.

packages.name: Whatever's Left
packages.contents: the clothes on your back, a bedroll, a pocketknife (Switchblade), less than a day's food.

packages.name: One Bag, Ready to Move
packages.contents: a packed duffel bag, a Multitool, a hand-me-down phone (Smartphone) barely holding a charge.

packages.name: Borrowed Roof
packages.contents: a key to somewhere that isn't really yours, a Tactical flashlight, one good coat.

packages.name: Shelter Queue
packages.contents: a sleeping bag, a Switchblade, a Straw water filter, and the schedule of which places still take you after nine.

packages.name: Car That Runs, Mostly

packages.name: Day Labor
packages.contents: steel-toed boots, a Hand saw, work gloves, and a phone number that sometimes calls back.

packages.name: Off the Grid
packages.contents: a Tent, a Fire starter kit, Water purification tablets, and a Compass older than you are.

packages.name: Busker
packages.contents: an instrument worth more than everything else you own, a Skateboard, a hat to put down, and a corner that's yours by nine a.m.

packages.name: Kitchen Back Door

packages.name: The Squat

packages.name: Scrapper

packages.name: Everything in the Backpack

packages.name: Weekend Warrior
